newsitem.title: USA: Comcast Corp unit sells $1.7 bln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Comcast Corp unit sells $1.7 bln in debt.

text.p: The following issue from Comcast Corp unit, Comcast Cable Communications Inc was priced on Thursday in the private placement market, according to market sources.
The deal was increased to $1.7 billion, from an initial size of $1.0 billion to meet investor demand, sources said.
